publisher: Daniela/OpenClaw through Bogdan's existing repository-admin browser session

candidate_inputs.browser_launch: playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True) using the package-selected default executable

test_target.python_abi: cp312; actual compatible wheel tags must be recorded
test_target.application_abi_must_not_substitute: CPython 3.13 / slim Bookworm / linux-amd64 is the separate APP bundle
test_target.runner_selection: Engineer must identify a standard GitHub-hosted Linux runner and exact target environment meeting these values; no runner availability or egress is asserted here
test_target.consumer: Assurance's existing authorized worker, in a fresh task-owned isolated environment; exact target values must be checked before installation

execution_preconditions: Exact reviewed Engineer workflow/helper commit, paths and SHA-256 values, with this input contract's enclosing commit and digest
Operator-verified standard hosted runner label, OS/image identity, architecture and exact Python selection/provenance; target glibc and ABI demonstrated
Complete exact required endpoint/redirect inventory for every action, tool, interpreter, index, wheel, browser and artifact operation, plus evidence that each is permitted on the selected runner
Only permitted repository-local/GitHub-authored actions, pinned to immutable identities, read-only default GITHUB_TOKEN, no new secrets or permission expansion
Explicit dependency-only trigger and inputs; no application deployment, host installation, full pilot acceptance run or automatic cross-system dispatch
Existing administrator publication route confirmed for the exact reviewed bytes; publication and execution receipts must be captured separately

required_bundle.root: TEST/ (distinct archive and manifest identity from APP)
files: requirements.in copied from the exact TC-D1 input
requirements.lock: all active direct/transitive requirements exactly pinned with SHA-256 hashes, compatible with the declared TEST target
wheelhouse/: complete binary wheel closure, including any explicitly required offline installer/bootstrap tools separately identified
wheel-inventory.json: distribution/version, filename, size, SHA-256, wheel tags, source URL, final URL/redirect chain and provenance for every wheel

resolver.json: interpreter/OS/libc/tags, resolver and installer versions, tool provenance/hashes, resolution command/flags, index configuration without secrets, dependency graph and complete resolution logs

browser/: complete package-selected Chromium cache/distribution closure for the suite's default headless launch, including headless shell or auxiliary binaries when required by that Playwright package

browser-inventory.json: Playwright wheel identity and embedded browser descriptor digest, selected platform, Chromium revision and browser version, every archive URL/final URL/checksum, extracted executable/path/tree checksums and permissions
runtime-libraries.json: exact OS/release, glibc version, required shared libraries with versions/paths and supplied-vs-already-present disposition, missing-library check and launch evidence
bundle-manifest.json: every payload file except this manifest, with relative path, byte length and SHA-256; separate manifest/archive digests in the operator handoff avoid self-reference

provenance.json: repository, source/workflow/helper commits and digests, operator, run/attempt/job IDs, runner image, artifact ID/name, creation/expiry times, service-reported digest and independently measured payload/archive digests
retrieval.json: existing permitted artifact retrieval method and operator-controlled persistent copy location, retention, copied-byte checksum and verification receipt before CI expiry
evidence/: full resolution, packaging, compatibility and producer smoke logs with real exit statuses, failures retained and bounded display summaries
lock_rules: Resolve on or explicitly for the exact TEST interpreter/platform and record the complete compatible tag set; universal and abi3 wheels are allowed only if compatible
No guessed transitive versions/hashes, unpinned dependency, editable/VCS reference, sdist build, hidden index fallback or unresolved environment marker
Every lock entry must map to supplied verified wheel bytes; every supplied installed wheel must map back to the lock and inventory
No reuse of APP wheels or APP lock as evidence of TEST compatibility
Installer/resolver/bootstrap tooling is separately pinned and inventoried; do not silently upgrade pip during offline consumption
browser_rules: Derive the selected browser revision from the verified Playwright 1.56.0 wheel's embedded browser descriptor and platform selection, not a mutable browser tag or remembered release number
Capture the complete distribution needed by chromium.launch(headless=True); chromium executable alone is insufficient if the default launch selects a headless shell
Preserve cache layout, executable modes and the exact executable actually launched; compare actual browser.version() and executable identity to the inventory
No host snap/system-browser substitution, executable_path override, on-demand browser download or host-package installation
A working CI browser is producer evidence only; consumer compatibility and launch remain to be verified in Assurance's authorized worker

required_per_operation: exact initial URL and all required redirect/CDN/storage URLs or separately explained dynamic host rules
access method and existing authority, without credentials
observed result and any unresolved precondition
categories: GitHub workflow/action source and helper retrieval
exact CPython/runtime and installer tooling source
Python index metadata, resolver dependencies and all wheel file hosts
Playwright-selected Chromium/headless-shell/auxiliary archive hosts and redirects
GitHub artifact upload/download and operator persistent-copy transport
endpoint_inventory_contract.worker_denied_routes: Remain denied. This contract does not authorize local PyPI/Docker Hub retries, mirror/proxy changes or connection changes.
endpoint_inventory_contract.uncovered_endpoint: Stop before execution; return exact capability/endpoint, proposed narrow change, responsible operator and rollback to CEO. No blanket access request.

unresolved_measured_values: Engineer workflow/helper commit, paths and digests
selected runner and exact target runtime provenance
resolved transitive versions, wheel filenames and hashes
Chromium revision/version, archive and extracted-file hashes, library inventory
publication/run/attempt/job/artifact identities and immutable payload digest
authorized retrieval method and persistent-copy checksum/retention
Assurance offline installation and headless launch evidence
gate: Any unresolved required field blocks execution/release or, for run-derived values, blocks supply acceptance at that later stage. Preparation is not TC.V qualification, source acceptance, application acceptance or permission to execute.
